summary: Iteration 2 testing of RENÉGADE HATS redesign (dark western header, cinematic hero, featured grid, promo panels, newsletter, footer, mobile layout) plus regressions. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (products order+CAD prices, _id excluded, custom-requests, contact, newsletter valid+422+admin visibility, Stripe checkout session + 409 on sold, admin auth + toggle sold). Frontend desktop 1536px: nav-story-link (ABOUT->/story), search dialog opens + result navigates to /shop/the-renegade, nav-account-button->/admin, cart drawer opens, 6 featured cards in correct order with correct slugs, favorite toggle persists after reload (localStorage), featured card click -> product page, promo-custom-cta->/custom, promo-story-cta->/story, newsletter success, all 5 footer socials + 5 footer page links present, returns link -> /shipping#returns, /privacy renders. Mobile 390x800: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), hero-image-mobile visible, hero-shop-cta + hero-custom-cta-mobile bottom at ~582px (fits above 800px fold), featured grid computed grid-template-columns = '173px 173px' (2 columns), hamburger menu opens + mobile-nav-shop-link navigates. Regression: shop product-add-button-the-renegade -> cart-drawer -> cart-checkout-button redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_..., admin-login-button with passcode renegade2026 opens Back Room with admin-tab-subs tab showing newsletter subscribers.
critical_code_review_comments: Testid naming inconsistency between review request and implementation (not bugs): request references 'search-icon-button/account-icon-button/cart-icon-button' but code uses 'nav-search-button/nav-account-button/nav-cart-button'; request references 'nav-about-link' but ABOUT nav item has id='story' so actual testid is 'nav-story-link'; request references '*-renegade-state' but slugs are 'the-renegade/midnight-renegade/renegade-red/the-outlaw/the-wanderer/the-shaman'. Consider aligning docs OR adding aliased testids.
FavButton has no aria-pressed attribute; favorite state is only communicated visually via SVG 'fill-[#C87D53]' class. Add aria-pressed={on} for accessibility and more deterministic tests.

Hero on mobile 390x800: shop CTA bottom at ~582px — meets 'CTAs visible without scrolling' requirement, but is below the stated 650–750px minimum hero height in the request. If a 650–750px hero is required, the current hero is shorter than spec (could be intentional since 'without scrolling' is the explicit requirement).
Still relevant from iter 1: stripe.Price.list(lookup_keys=[...]) per slug on each checkout can hit rate limits for larger carts.
